Definition: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain
BiblicalUsage: Chamac is violence, wrong, unjust gain. The earth was filled with violence before the flood, the law forbids putting your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness, a false witness rises up to testify what is wrong, and the cruelty done to Jerubbaal's seventy sons came home on Abimelech.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe violence in this word is not only the sword: it is the false witness, the unrighteous hand, and the cruelty that comes home. God drowned the violent earth, and He will drown the violent tongue too.
RelatedEvents: Noah and the Flood; Abimelech's Rise and Fall
